# Private-format manifest fixtures

These fixtures are generated by the WaterStructureCpp-owned Go helper; the
Fatalder/WaterStructure oracle source is not modified.

Regenerate from `tools/go_manifest`:

```powershell
go run ./cmd/private_fixtures -output ..\..\tests\fixtures\private_formats
```

Run the Go/C++ acceptance matrix from the project root:

```powershell
tools\run_manifest_matrix.ps1 `
  -CaseFile tools\manifest_private_cases.json `
  -OutputDirectory tmp-cli\private-matrix `
  -MemoryLimitMiB 500 `
  -Force
```

`sibi-unsupported.sibi` intentionally verifies the current oracle capability:
both implementations recognize SIBI, then return a parse/capability error.
The Go oracle explicitly states that its SIBI parser is not implemented because
the specification and samples are unavailable, so no C++ protocol is invented.
